segment_summary: এই প্রত্যাবর্তন কেবল একটি ঘটনা নয়, বরং এটি মানব আত্মার সেই আদিম স্পন্দনের বিজয়, যা চরম প্রতিকূলতার মুখেও তার ভেতরের দীপশিখা নিভতে দেয়নি।

segment_enrichment.angle: Addressing the void: Framing the entire poem as a dialogue spoken to an unseen/absent figure—Lkhindor who has returned but whose response remains eternally unheard.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: Inside an ancient, sealed-off chamber of the homestead (lhouho bashorghor analogue), untouched by sunlight; Desire: To share a moment where they acknowledge that survival has permanently altered their internal chemistry; Obstacle: The pressure to resume conventional life roles.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Focus on the Unspoken Treaty: Treating the marriage bond (sathjanom) less as romance and more as a solemn pact against societal chaos, tested by elemental forces.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The feeling of cold, anchored permanence when touching weathered river clay from their vigil (touch).
segment_enrichment.research_question: How can 'ontological necessity' be rendered in evocative Bangla diction without sounding purely academic?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: Alternating between intensely visual, static imagery (the landscape) and rapid, kinetic internal thought streams.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike earlier chapters focused on battle and tension, this piece rests entirely in 'residue'; the poetry must evoke an aftermath characterized by heavy silence rather than ecstatic release.
